verdict.rationale: Swell ships an official CLI (@swell/cli, documented at developers.swell.is/apps/cli and verified installable/runtime via npm) explicitly geared toward AI-native workflows: docs describe agents picking up 'the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop,' and a public skills repo packages this for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code plugin marketplace). missing for 10: no independent third-party review of the CLI's AI-native ergonomics beyond vendor docs and the runtime probe.
